plain: To empty a place of its people through war, disease or force.

webster.text: To dispeople; to unpeople; to deprive of inhabitants, whether by death, or by expulsion.

example.quote: A due observance of treaties makes nations more friendly to each other, and is the only means of rendering less frequent those mutual hostilities which tend to depopulate and ruin contending nations.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
